Publication-ready model comparison table

Source: R/model_comparison_table.R
mysterycall_model_comparison_table.Rd

Takes a named list of fitted mysterycall_poisson_model and/or mysterycall_nb_model objects and produces a formatted comparison table suitable for inclusion in a manuscript. Columns include AIC, BIC, their deltas, Pearson overdispersion (phi), and the NB dispersion parameter (theta). The winning model is marked with "*".

Usage

mysterycall_model_comparison_table(
  models,
  criterion = c("aic", "bic"),
  digits = 1L
)

Arguments

models

A named list (length >= 2) of model objects. Each element must be a mysterycall_poisson_model or mysterycall_nb_model.

criterion

Character vector. The first element ("aic" or "bic") determines which criterion selects the winner. Default c("aic", "bic").

digits

Integer. Decimal places for AIC, BIC, and phi columns. Default 1L.

Value

A data frame with columns Model, Family, N, Params, AIC, BIC, DeltaAIC, DeltaBIC, Phi (Pearson), Theta, Winner. Winner is "*" for the best model under criterion[1] and "" otherwise. The data frame carries an attribute "winner" with the winning model name.

See also

mysterycall_select_best_model() for a simpler AIC/BIC/LRT comparison; mysterycall_auto_model() for automatic model selection.

Other manuscript: mysterycall_combined_results_table(), mysterycall_export_results_docx(), mysterycall_flow_diagram(), mysterycall_format_results_table(), mysterycall_literature_table(), mysterycall_materials_methods(), mysterycall_methods_paragraph(), mysterycall_multi_model_table(), mysterycall_results_report(), mysterycall_sample_size_text(), mysterycall_save_plot(), mysterycall_sensitivity_table(), mysterycall_strobe_checklist(), mysterycall_strobe_flow(), mysterycall_summarize_demographics(), mysterycall_table2(), print.mysterycall_materials_methods(), print.mysterycall_model_comparison_table(), print.mysterycall_multi_model_table(), print.mysterycall_results_report(), print.mysterycall_strobe_checklist(), print.mysterycall_table2()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
tbl <- mysterycall_model_comparison_table(
  list(
    "Base model"  = poisson_fit,
    "+ Setting"   = poisson_fit2,
    "NB full"     = nb_fit
  )
)
print(tbl)
}
